system.summary: The logiwurm breathes up to three times/day (SV 12, no CP; range 1d10 (OR 9-10)+20 m, cone 6 m wide).
system.description:
Like other dragons, the logiwurm has a breath weapon (not by spending any Combat Point, but by making a SV12 roll). This one is called Fire breath. The logiwurm can make up to three breath attacks per day.

The breath has a range of 1d10 (OR 9-10) +20 meters, forming a cone 6 meters in diameter at its farthest end. The logiwurm’s profile specifies 3d10 (OR 7-10) damage.
